values.note: Standard non-electric and tent sites $25, standard electric $35, RV full hook-up $48, electric group shelter $65; the same in recreation.gov's 2024-2028 rate tables.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233679/rates (Peak Season 2026-04-01 to 2026-10-05 and 2027-2028: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $25, STANDARD ELECTRIC $35, FULL HOOK-UP $48), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233679 (3 bookable RV ELECTRIC sites list 50-amp, water and sewer; 6 bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list 50-amp, 26 list 30-amp) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233679 (amenities 'Electricity', 'Water Hookups'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov lists 50 bookable RV-capable sites (3 RV full hook-up, 32 standard electric, 15 standard non-electric) besides 10 tent-only, 31 hike-to and group sites. Max vehicle lengths run 34-64 ft, mostly 40-50. Every RV site is back-in.

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233679 (site types, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233679 (Facilities: 'Flush toilets, showers, drinking water and a dump station are provided'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'All sites are 100% reservable', on recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777 only. Holiday weekends must be booked for the whole weekend, Friday through Sunday, with no refund for leaving early. 14 nights in any 30 consecutive days at the project.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233679 (notices: 'All sites are 100% reservable', 'Reservations must be made for the entire holiday weekend, Friday through Sunday'; facility_rules maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed 50-amp electric with water+sewer (3 full-hookup RV sites), reservable on rec.gov, $25 base. Changed fees high 35 -> 48 (the full hook-up site rate was left out). Added 50 back-in RV sites to 64 ft, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, all sites reservable (no walk-up), 14-night max, holiday whole-weekend rule in the note. Not stated: campground season (rate seasons only), booking window; rec.gov lists a 'militaryDiscount' rule with no wording, so discounts were left alone.
